shortDescription: UPSC CDS II Admit Card 2026 is available from 03 September 2026. Download the hall ticket for the Combined Defence Services Examination from the official UPSC portal.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the CDS II Admit Card 2026 for the Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026. Candidates can download their hall ticket from the official UPSC online portal.

Important Details

  • Admit card available: 03/09/2026
  • Examination date: 13/09/2026
  • Total vacancies: 451
  • Exam authority: Union Public Service Commission

How to Download

  1. Open the official UPSC online portal.
  2. Select the CDS II Admit Card 2026 link.
  3. Enter your registration number or email ID and password or date of birth.
  4. Download and print the admit card.
  5. Verify your name, photograph, exam centre, date and reporting time.

Carry the printed admit card and a valid photo identity proof to the examination centre. Download the admit card only from the official UPSC portal.
editorNotes: SarkariResult.com is an independent information website and is not a government website. Verify the latest notice on the official UPSC domain.
importantInstructions: Check all details on the admit card. Carry a valid photo ID and reach the examination centre before the reporting time. Do not share login OTPs.
